history.text: Write a highly detailed, descriptive prompt of this image in English for an AI text-to-image generator (such as Midjourney, DALL-E, or Stable Diffusion). A young Asian man stands outdoors in a park-like setting. He has dark, curly hair and is wearing a black t-shirt with white lettering that reads "SEED" above a red cross symbol. He has on light blue, baggy sweatpants and dark grey slip-on shoes. He is looking up and to his right, with his right hand raised to his face, as if shielding his eyes or scratching his nose. To his left, a skateboard with a colorful, graphic design is leaning against a low, concrete wall. The wall is textured and shows signs of age and weathering. Behind the man, a lush green lawn stretches out, dotted with several trees with gnarled branches and some with small red flowers. In the background, a light-colored concrete wall can be seen. The lighting suggests it is daytime, possibly late afternoon, with soft light casting gentle shadows. The overall mood is relaxed and casual, with a hint of urban youth culture suggested by the skateboard and clothing style. The color palette is dominated by greens, greys, black, and light blue, with pops of red from the flowers and the skateboard design. The style is realistic with a slight artistic, candid feel.
